final: WITH observatory_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM observatory_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - (SELECT value FROM avg_share)) AS average_excess_share_pct FROM shares WHERE share_pct > (SELECT value FROM avg_share)
